locations.note: Surfers Paradise: the high-rise beach city of the Gold Coast is the festival's urban hub and night-race circuit.
Byron Bay's surf town and the rainforest coast behind it, the opening drive's lush end of the map.
The opal town of Coober Pedy stands in for the Outback, with its dugout houses and red dust tracks.
The Great Ocean Road's cliffs and the Twelve Apostles become the map's southern coast.
Ormiston Gorge in the West MacDonnell Ranges, the red rock of the map's desert interior.
The Yarra Valley's vineyards and farmland, the map's rolling green middle.
The Outback: sand, dry riverbeds and roadhouses between the coast and the gorge.
